name: Variable Blur
description: Box blur whose radius varies per pixel and channel with the brightness of a radius map (second input).

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Radius map (same size as the first input): black = min_r, white = max_r

params.name: min_r
params.description: Minimum blur radius, used where the map is black

params.name: max_r
params.description: Maximum blur radius, used where the map is white (raised to min_r + 1 when not above min_r)
